steps.subject: Free $100 off your next order!
body: My name is Matt Aertker, and I work with Customer Success here at Beema Health.
I'm reaching out to thank you for your purchase and to offer you a coupon for the next month.
If you have any issues or questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to me here at: {support_email}.
If you enjoyed your visit and would like a {coupon_amount} coupon for next month, please leave a Google review using the button below.
After we see the review, we will send the coupon.
